plugins.name: lotlytics
plugins.description: Real estate market intelligence — investment scores, rental yields, and market data for 895 US metros. Free for top 50 markets.

skills.name: analyze-property
skills.description: Analyze a specific property for investment potential — provide details or paste a Zillow link. Compares property price against market data. Free for top 50 markets.
skills.description_zh: 根据房产详情或Zillow链接分析投资潜力，对照市场数据评估价格；原说明称前50大市场可免费使用。

skills.name: explore-state
skills.description: Discover the best real estate investment markets in a US state — ranked by investment health score. Free tier shows major metros only.
skills.description_zh: 按投资健康评分发现美国指定州房地产投资市场；原说明称免费层只展示主要都市区。

skills.name: find-markets
skills.description: Find US real estate markets matching your investment criteria — filter by budget, rental yield, appreciation, and state. Requires Lotlytics Investor plan.
skills.description_zh: 按预算、租金收益、升值与州筛选美国房地产投资市场；原说明要求Lotlytics Investor订阅。

skills.name: head-to-head
skills.description: Compare two US real estate markets side-by-side — prices, yields, appreciation, migration, and a winner verdict. Requires Lotlytics Investor plan.
skills.description_zh: 并列比较两个美国房地产市场的价格、收益、升值及迁移，并给出优胜判断；原说明要求Lotlytics Investor订阅。

skills.name: market-report
skills.description: Generate a full investment report for a US real estate market — prices, rental yield, health score, and investment verdict. Free for top 50 markets.
skills.description_zh: 生成美国房地产市场完整投资报告，包含价格、租金收益、健康评分与投资判断；原说明称前50大市场免费。

skills.name: portfolio-check
skills.description: Analyze 2-3 real estate markets as an investment portfolio — diversification, yield balance, and risk spread. Requires Lotlytics Investor plan.
skills.description_zh: 将2至3个房地产市场作为投资组合分析，评估分散化、收益平衡与风险分布；原说明要求Lotlytics Investor订阅。
